title: A TABLE VAL parameter is evaluated in the filter context of the call and not again in the body
query: DEFINE FUNCTION CountRowsNow = ( t : TABLE VAL ) => COUNTROWS ( CALCULATETABLE ( t, ALL ( 'Date' ) ) )

source.quote: The 'Sales' table is already filtered by the year before entering the function, so ALL('Date') inside the function has no effect.
source.supports: the page gives this function and call (with a fiscal year filter) and explains the result

derivation: The argument Sales is evaluated by the caller under Year = 2023: rows 1, 2, 3 (January and February 2023) and 4 (2023-12-31), 4 rows. ALL ( Date ) in the body does not evaluate it again.
